episode_summary: Kim Rittberg discusses the importance of incorporating personal content into social media to boost engagement and build connections. She emphasizes the use of video content, both long-form and short-form, to establish expertise and credibility. The episode provides actionable tactics for real estate agents to enhance their personal brand and maintain client relationships during the summer.
